description: An upright teardrop outline holds a small sprig: a vertical stem with short branches angling up on both sides. The sprig rises from a curved ground line spanning the lower part of the drop.
A single upright teardrop with a pointed top and a full rounded base. A short diagonal highlight stroke sits inside its lower right.
A small teardrop falls above a wide, irregular puddle whose lobed, wavy outline stretches across the lower half.
A flower head seen from the front: a central circle ringed by twelve long rounded petals that radiate evenly and touch, forming a scalloped outer edge.
A puffy, three-lobed cloud-like cotton boll sits in a cup of three pointed bract leaves, above a short curved stem trailing down to the lower left.
A five-petal flower with a ringed centre sits on a short stem above a tapered flower pot with a wide rim band.
A cup-shaped tulip head with a V-notched top sits on a straight stem. Two thin leaves curve outward from the base of the stem and meet it in a point.
A cup-shaped tulip head with a V-notched top sits on a straight stem. Two thin leaves curve outward from the base of the stem and meet it in a point.
An upright tulip bloom of overlapping petals, with a small diamond gap at its tip, sits on a straight stem. Two pointed leaves branch from the stem on either side.
A flower head of five rounded petals around a ringed centre sits on a straight stem, with two pointed leaves branching out on either side.
A tall rounded rosebud with a spiralling petal curl inside sits on a straight stem, with two pointed leaves branching out on either side.
A scalloped outline of rounded petals surrounds a large circular centre holding a simple smiling face: two short eye strokes and a curved mouth.
A simple house with a pitched roof and a small square door stands on a long ground line. Two short parallel diagonal strokes rise from the ground to the right of the house.
A shorter rounded hill stands in front of a taller peak with a zigzag snowcap, both on a flat base line. A small cloud floats at the upper left.
Two horizontal wavy lines: a longer line of three waves on top and a shorter line of two waves beneath it, aligned to the left.
A small birdhouse with a pitched roof and arched entrance sits on top of a vertical trunk. Two branches curve out from the trunk to rounded cloud-shaped foliage on either side.
Two triangular mountain peaks sit at the upper left, with pine trees at the upper right and lower left. A dashed trail winds from between the peaks down to the lower right.
A half sun with short rays arcs at the upper left. Below, two sunflowers with toothed, gear-like heads and open centres stand on short stems with small leaves; the right one is larger.
Two rounded trees stand side by side on a horizontal ground line, the right one taller with a short branch off its trunk. A second parallel line runs beneath the ground line.
Three simple V-shaped birds fly across the top, the middle one lower than the other two. Three rows of rolling waves fill the lower half.
A half sun with five short rays sits on the horizon above two rows of rolling waves, the upper wave line crossing the base of the sun.
A cloud-shaped canopy tops an S-curving, double-lined trunk that rises from a wide, shallow trapezoid pot with a rim band.
An upright columnar cactus with a rounded top and two thin upturned arms, one on each side, rises from a tapered pot with a wide rim.
Two broad leaves spread from a short stem in a V above a tall tapered pot with a rim.

concept: Cactus with Rounded Arms in Pot
description: A tall cactus column with two plump rounded arms, one on each side, rises from a tapered pot with a wide rim.
A bud of three pointed petals sits on a short straight stem: a tall central petal overlaps two side petals that flare outward and upward to pointed tips.

A straight stem rises from a flat ground line and splits into two pointed leaves spreading left and right, each with a central vein stroke.
A slightly leaning stem rises from a flat ground line and ends in two broad rounded leaves: a larger one to the upper left and a smaller one to the right.
A straight stem on a flat ground line holds an upright pointed leaf at its top and two broad pointed leaves spreading to either side below it.
A bud of three pointed petals sits on a short straight stem: a tall central petal overlaps two side petals that flare outward and upward to pointed tips.
Two feathery grain stalks with angled side barbs, one upright and one leaning, rise above a low rounded mound overlapping a flatter one on a ground line. The lower shapes are hard to identify.
A rose bloom with a cupped outer petal and layered inner petals sits on a straight stem, with two pointed leaves branching out on either side.
Three small tulip heads with notched tops and a small inner mark stand in a row on short stems inside a wide, rimmed rectangular planter.
A narrow fir tree of three stacked tiers with notched sides and a pointed top stands on a short straight trunk.
A wide cloud-shaped canopy with a bumpy top sits on a single straight trunk.
A horizontal cut log shows its end grain on the left as concentric rings. A short branch stub with a small leaf rises from its top, and short bark lines mark its side.
A tall narrow triangular tree on the left overlaps a circular round-canopy tree on the right. Each has a straight trunk rising into its canopy with short branch strokes.
A fir tree silhouette with one notched step on each side, a softly pointed top and a flat base stands on a short straight trunk.
A rounded three-lobed canopy sits on a straight trunk that rises through its centre, with two short branches forking upward inside the canopy.
A fir tree silhouette with one notched step on each side, a softly pointed top and a flat base stands on a short straight trunk.

Two overlapping pine trees stand at the right on short trunks. A flame burns at their lower left, with wavy smoke curls rising at the upper left and upper right.
A tree stump with a flared base and a zigzag broken top has short branch stubs sticking out of each side and three vertical bark lines on its face.
Three cut logs lie stacked in a pyramid, two below and one on top. Each shows a round end with a centre dot at its left and short bark lines along its side.
A person with a round head and arched shoulders stands with arms outstretched as short horizontal strokes. A small cloud floats at the upper left and a rayed sun shines at the upper right.
An upright pointed leaf stands in the centre of a wide bowl formed by two broad leaves curving out to either side with pointed tips, all on a short stem.
